subject: Staggered data residency & deletion plan for Aurora Health
messages:
From: Dave Hansen <dave.hansen@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aurora Health Legal <legal@aurorahealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Tailored residency & deletion windows for Aurora pilot

Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we finalize the pilot SOW, our security team has one outstanding ask: Aurora requires a staggered retention model based on data sensitivity buckets and a clear certified deletion timeline on termination. We attached a short spec (Aurora_Retention_Reqs_v1.pdf) — highlights below: 

- Patient PHI: must stay in US-only residency, retention window configurable between 30–180 days post-processing, with certified deletion within 30 days of the retention window end.
- PII-derived artifacts (indexing tokens): retention 90 days by default but can be extended to 365 days for specific projects.
- Logs/diagnostics: retained 180 days, then aggregated/anonymized; full raw logs deletable on request within 60 days.

Questions: can Redwood support staggered windows by data-class and provide deletion certificates (hash + timestamp + operator ID) and a retention audit trail in CSV? Also confirm whether deletion operations can be scheduled (e.g., phased eviction: warm -> cold -> purge) and reflected in the order form SLA.

If possible, please send a short proposal we can attach to legal. Looking for a TO-BE retention timeline and an explicit order-form clause for deletion certification.

—Dave
Dave Hansen
Director, Infrastructure Security
Aurora Health

Attachment: Aurora_Retention_Reqs_v1.pdf (spec summary)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Dave Hansen <dave.hansen@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tailored residency & deletion windows for Aurora pilot

Dave —

Appreciate the clear spec and the PDF. Short answer: yes, we can support a staggered retention model by data class and provide deletion certificates and an exportable audit trail. High-level proposal attached (redwood_orderform_draft.docx) and a sample CSV format for the retention audit (retention-schedule.csv). Key points: 

1) Residency: we will pin PHI to US-only hosts (region-level routing + account isolation).

2) Retention windows (configurable per data-class in the order form):
   - Option A (default): PHI 90 days, PII-derived 90 days, logs 180 days.
   - Option B (staggered): PHI 30/90/180 choices, PII 90/365, logs 60/180 (customer selects per data class).

3) Deletion timeline and certification:
   - Deletion jobs can be scheduled as staged evictions: warm -> cold (compressed) -> purge.
   - Final purge can be scheduled to run within 30 days after the configured retention end.
   - Certification payload: deletion timestamp, storage shard IDs, sha256 of deleted object list, operator ID, and job run-id. We can produce a signed JSON-LD artifact and a human-readable CSV audit exported from the console.

4) Order-form clause suggestion (included in the draft): specific retention windows as checkboxes, a checkbox to request deletion certification on contract termination (standard within 30 days), and a field to opt for accelerated purges (15-day SLA) for an additional fee.

Next steps I propose:
- Internal review by Product & Legal (cc'd).
- I can send a polished order-form paragraph for inclusion in the SOW and a short appendix on how certificates are produced.

Is Aurora ok with Option B as the baseline? If yes, I’ll prepare the order-form snippet and the required DocuSign placeholders.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Product — Privacy & Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_orderform_draft.docx, retention-schedule.csv
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-25T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Tailored residency & deletion windows for Aurora pilot — legal/term notes

Marcus / Karthik —

Looping in a few legal notes based on Dave's spec and your draft: 

- Deletion certification: recommend we limit the certification to metadata hashes + job-id + retention-policy-id. Avoid committing to returning any customer data contents in the certificate.
- Evidence retention: Redwood should retain the deletion job logs for 365 days (internal) to meet audit requests but clearly state in the order form that the customer receives the certificate only (not raw internal logs).
- Accelerated purge fee: propose a tiered fee: standard (30-day final purge) included, accelerated (15-day) +20% recurring, emergency (7-day) one-time onboarding fee + per-GB charge.

I added inline comments to the draft order form (see redwood_orderform_draft.docx). Karthik, can you confirm product feasibility for the 7-day emergency purge and whether we need additional runbook steps or manual operator involvement?

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Legal Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Dave Hansen <dave.hansen@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aurora Health Legal <legal@aurorahealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-27T14:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tailored residency & deletion windows for Aurora pilot

Marcus / Neha —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft. Aurora is generally comfortable with Option B as the baseline. A few follow-ups before legal signs off: 

1) Deletion certificate format: can you provide a one-page example of the signed certificate and the CSV audit export (column headers + sample row)? We want to drop that into our vendor assessment.
2) Proof of execution: will Redwood expose a deletion-job API endpoint that returns job status and the certificate download URL? We prefer an automated pull vs. a manual email attachment.
3) Data-location proof: can you provide a short statement confirming the control-plane will not replicate PHI to non-US regions and an auditable tag in the metadata showing the host-region for those objects?

If you can provide the sample certificate and an API contract snippet, we can attach those to the SOW and proceed. Also include the DocuSign placeholder for the accelerated purge fee checkbox (link preferred).

If feasible, can you send these artifacts by Friday? Aurora's procurement wants the order form + artifacts to run parallel with the PO paperwork.

—Dave
Dave Hansen
Director, Infrastructure Security
Aurora Health
